name: Rot Cubs
source:
Theo, Sunshine and Beatrice share only few things in common: They are 20 years old, and they are taken to live at Rotwood Manor. Yet the old manor deep in the woods hold mysteries, and there is definetly something weird going on.

Rot Cubs is coming-of-age horror visual novel. It stars colorful cast of anthropomorphic animals who try to survive their though life in a facility that does not look kindly upon them.

[From [url=https://klaineka.itch.io/rot-cubs-chapter-1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
西奥、阳光与碧翠丝的共同点并不多：他们都二十岁，也都被送到腐木庄园生活。然而，森林深处的古老宅邸藏着诸多谜团，这里显然正在发生某些怪事。

《Rot Cubs》是一部关于成长的恐怖视觉小说。一群个性鲜明的拟人动物，试图在这间对他们毫不友善的机构里，熬过艰难的生活。

[摘自[url=https://klaineka.itch.io/rot-cubs-chapter-1]Itch.io[/url]]
